title: Sparse uniform approximation
statement: Let $n>0$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\delta>0$. If $4n\|\widehat f\|_1^2/\delta^2\le s$, where $s$ is a nonnegative integer and $\|\widehat f\|_1$ is the sum of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$, then there is a function $q$ on the cube with at most $s$ nonzero Fourier coefficients such that $|f(x)-q(x)|<\delta$ at every point $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
